artworks.displayTitle: Depth and Values — AI Demo Study
artworks.label: AI-generated demo study
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI-generated fictional learner exercise for a painting-learning hackathon prototype.
Input image 1 is a composition and scene reference only, not an edit target.
Create a new, deliberately simplified small gouache study inspired by the wide misty mountain coast in the reference: dark angular foreground cliffs and sparse pine silhouettes, a small cliffside Chinese temple in the middle distance, layered mountains receding into pale blue sea mist, a tiny warm lantern accent. Preserve the panoramic landscape composition and recognizable main scene, but reinterpret it as a rough 15-minute three-value block-in exercise. Omit the foreground characters to concentrate on landscape depth.
Style/medium: amateur gouache sketch, large blunt brush shapes, visible opaque brush marks and paper texture, imperfect edges, sparse architectural detail. Use only three principal value groups: dark foreground, medium-blue middle ground, pale distant haze, plus a small muted warm lantern accent. The study should feel exploratory and unfinished, not a polished professional studio painting.
Composition: wide landscape, approximately 2.3:1, the entire image is the painted study without a mockup or border.
Constraints: no signatures, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. Do not claim this is an actual human student's work; it is a generated example used for a demo.
artworks.postProcessing: None. Copied original generated PNG into workspace.

artworks.displayTitle: Warm/Cool Color Experiment — AI Demo Study
artworks.label: AI-generated demo study
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI-generated fictional learner color experiment for a painting-learning hackathon prototype.
Input image 1 is a composition and scene reference only, not an edit target.
Create a new, visibly distinct color-study attempt at the same misty mountain-coast scene: broad angular cliff masses and sparse pine silhouettes, a tiny Chinese temple on an isolated rocky promontory, a sea of atmospheric haze and receding mountain ridges, one small glowing lantern. Keep the recognizable wide landscape arrangement of the reference, omitting the foreground characters.
Style/medium: expressive amateur gouache exercise, broad blocky brushwork with some more-resolved silhouette edges and a few temple marks; simplified forms rather than rendering. This attempt experiments with warm/cool contrast: desaturated blue-green and lavender mountains, pale peach/coral haze near the horizon, deep indigo foreground, and small ochre-orange temple/lantern accents. Noticeably warmer and more colorful than a blue three-value block-in; a distinct new attempt with its own shape decisions. Keep the amateur practice-painting character and visible brush strokes; not a polished studio-original quality.
Composition: panoramic landscape, approximately 2.3:1; entire image is the painting, no mockup or border.
Constraints: no signatures, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. This is a generated fictional demo study, not evidence of human learning.
artworks.postProcessing: None. Copied original generated PNG into workspace.
